statistical_method: two-sided exact paired binomial (exact McNemar) with Holm correction across three frozen comparisons

trajectory_definitions.ngram_repeated_fraction: sum(count-1)/number_of_ngrams over generated token IDs for n=4,8,16
trajectory_definitions.ngram_unique_ratio: unique ngrams/number_of_ngrams over generated token IDs for n=4,8,16
trajectory_definitions.claim_events: Frozen V4 enumerate_claim_events; only committed, unrejected, integer-normalized events form the claim sequence
trajectory_definitions.post_commit_fraction: characters after first committed claim end divided by total response characters
trajectory_definitions.answer_changes: number of adjacent value changes in the committed integer claim sequence
trajectory_definitions.retractions: number of Frozen V4 events flagged retracted
